Tuesday Night Social Road Ride (Taco Tuesdays)

Anchorage, AK · Muldoon / East Anchorage · Road · Gravel

No-drop

Tuesday Night Social Road Ride (Taco Tuesdays) is a road and gravel group ride in Anchorage, AK. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:30 pm from Bartlett High School student parking lot. Pace: no-drop, two-abreast peloton.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: no-drop, two-abreast peloton. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tuesday Night Social Road Ride (Taco Tuesdays) group ride

A no-drop Tuesday night road ride started to give Anchorage roadies something they can count on every week. Meets at the Bartlett High lot, rides the Glenn Highway path out toward Eagle River, and ends at tacos or pizza. Rain or shine. Road or gravel bikes recommended.
